capabilities: Export notes to tagged PDF/A-2A and PDF/UA-1 files
Export canvas boards as accessible PDFs with card layout
Translate Obsidian syntax, callouts, embeds and tables to print markup
Print selected frontmatter properties as a table
Configure page size, fonts, margins and footer page numbers
disambiguation: Not a local PDF generator; it uploads note or canvas content to a remote layout service and cannot work offline.
extras: Requires network access; note markdown, embedded notes, inlined images and canvas file data are POSTed to the server. Anonymous use is rate limited (60/hour, 200/day) and capped at 20 pages; an API key raises limits and costs render credits. Uploaded source and output are retained 7 days. API URL is configurable for self-hosting. Canvas requests are capped at 25MB, board JSON at 2MB, 60 images and 10 PDFs (5MB each).
problem: Obsidian's built-in export prints the rendered view, which produces untagged PDFs without heading structure, alt text, or table headers, so it fails accessibility and archival requirements.

relations.evidence: a vtable fenced block (Vtable plugin) | an HTML table with merged cells
The adapter turns on by itself while the Structural Tables plugin is enabled

summary: PDF exporter that sends note and canvas markdown to the makespdf.com API to produce tagged, accessible PDF/A-2A and PDF/UA-1 files in the vault.
